row.evidence: TrustArc's help centre 'SCIM Support Client API Guide' documents GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE /external/api/v2/scim/Users and /Groups, while TrustArc publishes no pricing (trustarc.com/pricing/ is 404; products lead to 'Request a Demo').
row.notes: Quote-only: TrustArc publishes no plans or prices (trustarc.com/pricing/ returns 404; every product page leads to 'Request a Demo'), so SCIM can only be bought through sales. A generic SCIM 2.0 API is documented in the help centre (Users, Groups, Schemas, ResourceTypes, ServiceProviderConfig at login.truste.com/external/api/v2/scim); SCIM Groups map to Permission Profiles that carry roles. SCIM auth (token source, expiry) and which modules or contracts include SCIM are not documented. SAML SSO is set up by TrustArc Support (staging then production), with an optional 'auto-create' JIT that gives new SSO users the lowest privilege. Okta's OIN 'TRUSTe' app (last updated 2014) is SWA only; no Entra gallery or JumpCloud app.

plans.notes: Modules (Assessment Manager, Cookie Consent Manager, Individual Rights Manager, Data Mapping & Risk Manager, PrivacyCentral, etc.) are sold by quote.

deprovision.notes: DELETE /Users/{id} is documented; whether PATCH active=false deactivates (the admin UI has De-Activate User) and what happens to the user's data is not documented.

attributes.notes: Only a 'Basic User Model' sample is published; no full attribute list.

roles.how: SCIM Groups are TrustArc Permission Profiles; roles assigned to a profile apply to its member users.

scim.notes: Documented in the help centre's 'SCIM Support Client API Guide' section (User, Group, Schema, ServiceConfig articles, Oct 2025). Version 2.0 is inferred from the core:2.0 schema URNs in the sample models. Base URL taken from the sample meta.location.

user_api.notes: No non-SCIM user-management API is documented; TrustArc's other APIs (Cookie Consent Manager, Individual Rights, Assessment Manager, Data Mapping) cover product data and use OAuth client credentials from api.trustarc.com.

okta.notes: OIN 'TRUSTe' app (last updated Apr. 29 2014) ticks only SWA (read from page markup). TrustArc's own Okta guide uses a custom SAML app.

entra.notes: No TrustArc tutorial in the Entra SaaS app tutorial list (toc.json checked).

google.notes: Not checked; no TrustArc guide for Google Workspace.

onelogin.notes: Not loaded (OneLogin blocks bots); no TrustArc OneLogin guide.

jumpcloud.notes: No TrustArc entry in JumpCloud's integration guide list; integrate-with-trustarc returned 403.
